The 'Loadout' section's item rows have inconsistent left-padding for the icons versus the text, and the 'LV 30/28/22' labels on the right are not right-aligned to a consistent margin, creating a ragged edge. Differentiate path materials by branch: give each connecting line a subtle gradient or hue-shift matching its branch color (orange for Pyromancy, blue for Runeecraft, etc.) and increase the stroke contrast so branches are visually distinct. 3.
